contea di ritrovamento: Greater London (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP M IVL PHILIPPVS AVG ; R/ ANNONA AVGG

A Roman copper alloy coin: nummus of Philip I dating AD244-249. Sear no. 2453 RIC 28c. Obverse: Laureate and draped bust right. Obverse inscription: IMP M IVL PHILIPPVS AVG. Reverse: Annona standing left, modius at feet, S to left C to right. Reverse inscription: ANNONA AVGG. Die axis measurement: 12.00. Dimensions: diameter: 23.40mm; weight: 7.90g. Reference: Sear, D R. 1970. Roman Coins and Their Values. Seaby, London
